Hardware add-on

StormSimul Node

A solar-powered rain and water-level sensor mounted on an existing post beside a creek. It checks the forecast against real water levels during the storm.

₱10,500per unit, installed · one-time

Works with Premium and VIP plans.

Power
10 W solar panel, keeps running in blackouts
Water level
Ultrasonic, 0.2 to 6 m, never touches water
Rainfall
Tipping-bucket rain gauge
Link
LoRa radio to the barangay hall
Build
IP65 enclosure, stainless clamps, about 2.5 kg

Questions

Why is it free for residents?

Flood safety information should reach every household, including families who cannot pay. Barangays, businesses and cities fund the service through their plans.

Can a barangay pay from its disaster fund?

Barangay Pro and the StormSimul Node are priced to fit within a barangay’s local disaster risk reduction fund, which RA 10121 sets at no less than 5% of its estimated regular revenue. Check with your treasurer for the rules that apply to your LGU.

Do I need a sensor node to use Premium?

No. Premium works from forecasts and flood hazard maps alone. Nodes add live water-level readings for the creeks and roads you choose.

Is StormSight an official warning service?

No. It is a preparedness tool. Always follow PAGASA and LGU advisories.
